description.text: Study Duration July 22 - August 16 (4 weeks) Enrollment No limited, joining in the class in the middle is acceptable. Class Arrangement Time Monday-Friday Weekend Note 08:00 -12:00 Chinese Lessons City Tour (Mount Lao, May Fourth Square, Eight Guan etc.) Chinese Traditional Culture Class opens only there are over 10 applicants. City Tour opens only for there are over 15 applicants Students only need to pay travel fee for City Tour.The university provides vehicle and escorts. 14:00 -16:00 Chinese Traditional Culture (Tue. or Wed.) Levels There are elementary (A class, B class), intermediate (C class, D class) and advanced (E class)levels. A class: beginner-level class, mainly in elementary conversation and listening B class: elementary level class, focus on listening and conversation, basic grammar at the same time C and D class: improving intermediate conversation ability, listening and writing abilities etc. E class: improving advanced conversation ability, listening, grammar and writing abilities etc, learn high HSK level at the same time. Note: Every level class can open only when there are over 5 applicants for each level. Teaching Materials The following teaching materials are all published by Beijing Language and Culture University except Advanced Chinese Reading. For elementary: Boya Chinese, History of Mandarin For intermediate: History of Mandarin For advanced: History of Mandarin, HSK Examination Intensive Teaching Materials, Advanced Chinese Reading (published by Peking University) Fees Expenses Fees (RMB) Note Tuition Fee 2,500/4 week, 4,000/8 week Exclusive of teaching material fee Accommodation Fee 80/day Single Room 40/day Double Room Deposit 500 Refund when check out Insurance Fee 185 Compulsory Network Fee 40/month Teaching Material Below 200 Net fee 40/month

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Copy of highest education certificate or studying proof Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 4.Resume Written in Chinese or in English
